mapper.select: SELECT c.*, cc.id AS contact_id, cc.customer_id, cc.contact_name, cc.contact_gender, cc.contact_position, cc.contact_department, cc.contact_phone, cc.contact_mobile, cc.contact_email, cc.contact_wechat, cc.contact_qq, cc.contact_address, cc.is_primary, cc.is_decision_maker, cc.is_receiver, cc.birthday, cc.hobby, cc.sort_order FROM customers c LEFT JOIN customer_contacts cc ON c.id = cc.customer_id WHERE c.id = #{id} AND c.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY cc.sort_order ASC, cc.id ASC

SELECT c.*, u1.real_name AS sales_user_name, u2.real_name AS documentation_person_user_name, cc.id AS contact_id, cc.customer_id, cc.contact_name, cc.contact_gender, cc.contact_position, cc.contact_department, cc.contact_phone, cc.contact_mobile, cc.contact_email, cc.contact_wechat, cc.contact_qq, cc.contact_address, cc.is_primary, cc.is_decision_maker, cc.is_receiver, cc.birthday, cc.hobby, cc.sort_order, cc.remark AS contact_remark FROM customers c LEFT JOIN customer_contacts cc ON c.id = cc.customer_id LEFT JOIN users u1 ON c.sales = u1.id LEFT JOIN users u2 ON c.documentation_person = u2.id WHERE c.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY c.create_time DESC, cc.sort_order ASC, cc.id ASC
